name: The plush of my favorite villain came to life and he wants to f*ck
source:
You must still be dreaming, you must! No way this can be real.

Waking up only to find that the plushie of your favorite anime character has come to life and subsequently confesses his love and desire for you!? This sounds exactly like the plot of a bad hentai or a deeply self indulgence fanfic. Unfortunately this is all very real! HOW!? WHY!? … Is it wrong that you kinda want this? 

[From [url=https://d3adxfish.itch.io/villain-plush]itch.io[/url]]
